parsed.summary: The patch addresses the issue but may introduce regressions and lacks comprehensive tests.

issues.description: The patch may break existing behavior for other nested CompoundModels, as it changes the way the separability matrix is constructed.
The patch does not include any new tests to verify the correctness of the separability matrix for nested CompoundModels, leaving a risk of regressions.
The patch introduces a non-minimal change by modifying the `_cstack` function, which may affect other parts of the codebase. The change is not immediately clear in terms of maintainability.
